title: Google Ads Case Study for Chiropractors | T3 Chiropractic

facts.fact: The Mina Company reports that for its T3 Chiropractic Google Ads campaign, click-through rates consistently held between 3–5%.
The Mina Company reports that its Google Ads campaign for T3 Chiropractic delivered 100–150 clicks per month.
facts.quote: Ads delivered **100–150 clicks/month** with a low average cost of **$1.36–$2.79 per click**

facts.fact: The Mina Company reports an average cost per click of $1.36–$2.79 for the T3 Chiropractic Google Ads campaign.
facts.quote: a low average cost of **$1.36–$2.79 per click**

facts.fact: The Mina Company reports that the T3 Chiropractic Google Ads campaign generated up to 39 appointment requests in a single month.
facts.quote: Generated **up to 39 appointment requests in a single month**

facts.fact: The Mina Company reports that T3 Chiropractic's appointment conversions in March were 39, a 39% increase from the previous month.
facts.quote: March: 39 appointment conversions (**+39% from the previous month**)

facts.fact: The Mina Company reports that cost per click for T3 Chiropractic's Google Ads fell 24% in March compared with February.
facts.quote: **CPC reduced by 24%** (March) compared to February, improving efficiency

facts.fact: The Mina Company states that its chiropractic clients have achieved cost-per-click as low as $1.36 with Google Ads, citing T3 Chiropractic as an example.
The Mina Company's T3 Chiropractic engagement included writing monthly educational blog content for SEO.
facts.quote: Wrote monthly educational **blog content for SEO**
